import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the data
coffee_sales = pd.read_csv('data/coffee_sales.csv')

# Convert date and time columns to datetime
coffee_sales['date'] = pd.to_datetime(coffee_sales['date'])
coffee_sales['time'] = pd.to_datetime(coffee_sales['time'])

# Pivot the data to count the number of sales by product and size
sales_pivot = coffee_sales.pivot_table(index='product', columns='size', values='quantity', aggfunc='sum', fill_value=0)

# Create a heatmap
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 8))
sns.heatmap(sales_pivot, annot=True, cmap='Blues', fmt='d')
plt.title('Monthly Sales by Product and Size')
plt.xlabel('Size')
plt.ylabel('Product')
plt.xticks(rotation=45)
plt.yticks(rotation=45)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
